entities.summary: Julian Westbrook is chief investment officer of a macro hedge fund with the largest gold position among its peers. He trades gold based on central bank policy, the dollar, and inflation, and follows gold supply, including at Manh Choh, when sizing the fund’s position.

attributes.name: Curtis Lindqvist
attributes.policy_area: Mine jobs, local business, pavement damage, safety, and the environment
attributes.public_position: State legislator for the Tok district

entities.name: Curtis Lindqvist
entities.summary: Curtis Lindqvist represents Tok in the Alaska Legislature as state legislator for the Tok district. Mine jobs and local business matter in his district, alongside concerns raised at 2024 ore-haul meetings about pavement damage, safety, and the environment. He is expected to take a public position on the Redpoll Ridge Project.

entities.name: Tanya Rasmussen
entities.summary: Tanya Rasmussen operates heavy equipment at the Manh Choh mine and lives in Tok. She considers the mine job the best-paid work available near her home, follows the gold price, and believes it determines how long mining near Tok will last.

entities.name: Marcus Delgado
entities.summary: Marcus Delgado is a mine crew lead at Manh Choh, where mining began in late 2023 and is expected to last four to five years. He wonders where his next job will come from and sees the Redpoll Ridge Project as a possible opportunity.

attributes.name: Alaska Department of Transportation (DOT)
attributes.responsibility: State highways used by the Manh Choh ore haul; pavement damage, maintenance costs, and safety questions

entities.name: Alaska Department of Transportation (DOT)
entities.summary: The Alaska Department of Transportation is responsible for the state highways used by the Manh Choh ore haul. Its office handles pavement damage, maintenance costs, and safety questions raised by about 60 daily round trips of 95-foot ore trucks traveling to the Fort Knox mill.

attributes.name: regional Alaska Native corporation
attributes.organization_role: Regional Native corporation representative

entities.name: regional Alaska Native corporation
entities.summary: A regional Alaska Native corporation in Alaska’s Interior is represented by Sharon Delancey.

attributes.investment_role: Head of a bullion bank desk
attributes.name: Hannah Whitcombe

entities.name: Hannah Whitcombe
entities.summary: Hannah Whitcombe runs a bullion bank’s precious metals desk, making markets in physical gold and gold futures. She sees shifts in physical demand directly through her desk and follows supply news from producers such as Kinross.

attributes.name: Alaska Department of Natural Resources
attributes.responsibility: Deciding whether to approve the Redpoll Ridge Project application

entities.name: Alaska Department of Natural Resources
entities.summary: The Alaska Department of Natural Resources approved Manh Choh’s reclamation plan under Alaska state law AS 27.19.

attributes.community_role: Lodge owner on the Alaska Highway
attributes.name: Frank Abernathy

entities.name: Frank Abernathy
entities.summary: Frank Abernathy runs a lodge on the Alaska Highway near Tok. Mine workers and contractors fill some rooms, while ore-truck traffic and road wear bother his tourist guests, so the mine both helps and hurts his business.

attributes.name: Bureau of Land Management (BLM)
attributes.responsibility: Tracks whether new mining near Tok, including the Redpoll Ridge Project, would touch federal land or need federal permits.

entities.name: Bureau of Land Management (BLM)
entities.summary: The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) is led in Alaska by state director Raymond Takahashi. It tracks whether new mining near Tok, including the Redpoll Ridge Project, would affect federal land or require federal permits.

entities.name: Margaret Halloran
entities.summary: Margaret Halloran is Governor of Alaska and leads the state government. She weighs mining jobs and state revenue against opposition to the Manh Choh ore haul raised at 2024 public meetings, and sets the state’s position on mining tax. The state will be held responsible for its decision on the pending Redpoll Ridge Project.

attributes.name: Alaska Department of Natural Resources (DNR)
attributes.responsibility: Conducts field inspections of mine sites and checks that mines follow their approved reclamation plans.

entities.name: Alaska Department of Natural Resources (DNR)
entities.summary: The Alaska Department of Natural Resources approved the reclamation plan under which Manh Choh operates. It must decide on the Redpoll Ridge Project application, with Commissioner Douglas Renfrew considering effects on state revenue, jobs, and local opposition.

attributes.name: Heather Moravec
attributes.primary_concern: good jobs, clean water, and safe roads

entities.name: Heather Moravec
entities.summary: Heather Moravec is raising two children in Tok. She wants good jobs that keep young families in town, along with clean water and safe roads for her children; she knows Manh Choh brings jobs to Tok.

entities.name: Sofia Varga
entities.summary: Sofia Varga manages a mining-equity fund focused on North American gold producers. She compares mines by cost, mine life, and permitting risk, and treats Alaska’s decision on the Redpoll Ridge Project as a test of permitting risk in the state.

attributes.name: Alicia Mendoza
attributes.public_position: Regional official, Alaska Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC)

entities.name: Alicia Mendoza
entities.summary: Alicia Mendoza is a regional Alaska Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) official who works on water quality in the region around Tok. She follows water questions related to Manh Choh and would be involved in reviewing the water aspects of the Redpoll Ridge Project.

attributes.name: Ricky Santoro
attributes.work_location: Manh Choh haul to the Fort Knox mill

entities.name: Ricky Santoro
entities.summary: Ricky Santoro is an ore-haul truck driver on the Manh Choh haul to the Fort Knox mill and is new to the job. He moved north for the pay and would stay if more mining near Tok kept him working.

entities.name: Victor Hale's trend-following fund
entities.summary: Victor Hale’s fund is a trend-following commodity trading advisor (CTA) that trades gold futures on systematic signals. Its models add to positions when prices break out and cut them when trends turn.
